scripts.clean:all: npm run clean -w web && rm -rf node_modules
scripts.firebase:use: bash -lc 'set -a; : ${PRIVATE_DIR:?PRIVATE_DIR must be set}; [ -f "$PRIVATE_DIR/secrets/frontend.env" ] && . "$PRIVATE_DIR/secrets/frontend.env" || true; set +a; : ${FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID:?FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID must be set}; npm exec -w web firebase -- use "$FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID"'
scripts.firebase:create: bash -lc 'set -a; : ${PRIVATE_DIR:?PRIVATE_DIR must be set}; [ -f "$PRIVATE_DIR/secrets/frontend.env" ] && . "$PRIVATE_DIR/secrets/frontend.env" || true; set +a; : ${FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID:?FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID must be set}; npm exec -w web firebase -- projects:create "$FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID" --display-name "$FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID"'
scripts.firebase:deploy: bash -lc 'set -a; : ${PRIVATE_DIR:?PRIVATE_DIR must be set}; [ -f "$PRIVATE_DIR/secrets/frontend.env" ] && . "$PRIVATE_DIR/secrets/frontend.env" || true; set +a; : ${FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID:?FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID must be set}; npm run build -w web && npm exec -w web firebase -- deploy --project "$FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID"'
scripts.firebase:hosting:disable: bash -lc 'set -a; : ${PRIVATE_DIR:?PRIVATE_DIR must be set}; [ -f "$PRIVATE_DIR/secrets/frontend.env" ] && . "$PRIVATE_DIR/secrets/frontend.env" || true; set +a; : ${FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID:?FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID must be set}; npm exec -w web firebase -- hosting:disable --project "$FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID"'
